video_title: The Rapping Chef On His Viral Journey, Cooking for T-Mac & Carving Out His Own Lane | Cousins

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on his viral journey to becoming the Rapping Chef
quotes.excerpt: Everyone was making content, so I decided to jump on the train.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: How did you come up with, hey, I'm going to be the Rapping Chef? And did you know, or was that your game plan to get the followers and to to do this? Like, how how did this all come about?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: Man, it was super random. Everyone was making content, so I decided to jump on the train. I didn't know what it was going to turn into, but I stayed consistent and I mean, I'm still surprised of how it's turning out, you know, for real.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on Josh's early rapping days in Florida
quotes.excerpt: He was rapping back home in Florida. I always felt like he had great talent.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I remember he was rapping back home in Florida. I always felt like he had great talent. I always thought his play on words was amazing and this is something that he should pursue, but he was quiet. He didn't want to be out front. He wanted to be the guy that's writing the lyrics and creating that magic for someone else.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: That was true, yeah.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on his transition from shy rapper to cooking content creator
quotes.excerpt: I was super shy in my early twenties when I started rapping.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Take us back when you started rapping up until where you are today.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: I was super shy in my early twenties when I started rapping. I love to do it, but I didn't want to do it in front of people. I guess in fear of being critiqued. I get to my mid-twenties and nothing is really happening, so I kind of just fell back. And then I moved to Houston. I started cooking for bro and then at this time, this is COVID, so I'm seeing everyone on TikTok having fun. I started doing the regular cooking videos where you just narrate regular and it was not getting no motion. So I switched it up and I started rapping the thing and I repurposed that rap stuff into some content.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on Lil Wayne's influence on his rapping style
quotes.excerpt: Little Wayne, bro. Little Wayne. I was a Little Wayne fanatic high school.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Who is your favorite rappers or like your rapping style comes from who?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: Little Wayne, bro. Little Wayne. I was a Little Wayne fanatic high school. One of the first albums I ever bought. I took my whole style from him. How he would hop on someone else's beat and just kill it. I got that whole thing from him and just I'm talking about food instead of what, you know, typical things that rappers rap about.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on how Gordon Ramsay helped boost his social media following
quotes.excerpt: I swear I gained like 100,000 followers after Gordon Ramsay did that.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Who has taken a liking or saw you, whether there's a talk show, a radio show, a podcast? Who reached out to you to bring you on that platform?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: Early on, Nick Cannon. Nick Cannon brought me on the Nick show. He had a show on, I forget what channel or network, but they brought me out. We cooked. It was dope. Gordon Ramsay, early on, and a lot of my following came from that shoutout. I swear I gained like 100,000 followers after Gordon Ramsay did that.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on his first viral video featuring creme brulee
quotes.excerpt: I did creme brulee and I was rapping over Drake and Jay-Z pound cake beat.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: What's your first viral clip that propelled you to the level you're at now?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: I did creme brulee and I was rapping over Drake and Jay-Z pound cake beat. That was a fire post. And that's the one that Gordon Ramsay, he it's called duet it where you kind of stitch it and he made a video to it as well, kind of like in response. And yeah, I swear I got like 100,000 followers and that was a big moment for me.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on his most viewed video featuring white rice
quotes.excerpt: I think it's 30 million. It's a how to make white rice video.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: What is the highest viewed video I would say? What is the highest and what is that number?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: I think it's 30 million. It's a how to make white rice video. I just made plain white rice and it was to a song by a rock band called The Fray. But I didn't know that people the song had played a major part on the Grey's Anatomy show. So when I posted it, I'm seeing people comment all these Grey's Anatomy references. I was lost.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on the benefits of signing with a talent agency
quotes.excerpt: A year in is when I signed with the talent agency.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Do you sign with an agency? How does that work with content creators?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: A year in is when I signed with the talent agency. And the good thing about signing with a talent agency is because you no longer have to negotiate. You no longer have to prospect and find your own deals. They're doing everything for you. And plus, they know your worth when you don't know it.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady

quotes.excerpt: This dude loves Luka Doncic. He loves Luka, bro.

text_blocks.text: This dude loves Luka Doncic. He loves Luka, bro. He'll go he'll drive to Dallas to go see Luka, bro. Like he loves Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: Luka with the hookah, bro.

quotes.speaker: Josh
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh on why he loves Luka Doncic's playing style
quotes.excerpt: He's not scared to take the shot. He's just flashy with it, you know?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: What brings I guess draw Luka to your attention? Like what do you like about him?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh
text_blocks.text: Man, he's so just flashy with it, you know? He's not scared to take the shot. He might go seven for 40, but it's just the fact that he ain't scared. He going to keep trying and he might give you a 40 point triple double. I just like how how flashy he is, that's it.
